description: PAID ($0.10 USDC via x402 on Base): Verified B2B Person Enrichment, Work Email Finder & LinkedIn-to-Email Resolver powered by Apollo.io. Accepts partial identifiers—(1) first_name + last_name + company domain or organization_name, (2) LinkedIn profile URL (linkedin_url), or (3) email (reverse email lookup)—and returns a deterministic JSON profile with deliverable work email, verification status, job title, seniority (founder, C-suite, VP, director), company firmographics (headcount, industry, founded year), and full employment history. Zero signup or API key required.

inputSchema.description: B2B Person Enrichment & Verified Work Email Finder (Apollo.io): Resolve partial person identifiers—such as (1) first_name + last_name + company domain/organization_name, (2) LinkedIn profile URL (linkedin_url to email), or (3) work email (reverse email lookup)—into a deterministic B2B executive/prospect profile with verified work email, job title, seniority (founder, C-suite, VP, director), department, location, company firmographics (headcount, industry, founded year), and full employment history.

_x402_payment.description: Optional x402 signed payment payload (if not passed via HTTP X-PAYMENT header)

domain.description: Company website domain without protocol (e.g., 'apollo.io', 'stripe.com'). Strongly improves match precision.

email.description: Known work or personal email address for reverse-email enrichment into full LinkedIn, title, firmographics, and career history.

first_name.description: Target person's first name (e.g., 'Tim'). Best combined with last_name and domain or organization_name.

last_name.description: Target person's last name (e.g., 'Zheng'). Best combined with first_name and domain or organization_name.

linkedin_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL (e.g., 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/tim-zheng') to resolve directly into a verified work email and company profile.

name.description: Target person's full name (e.g., 'Tim Zheng') if first_name and last_name are not separated.

organization_name.description: Company or organization name (e.g., 'Apollo.io', 'Stripe') if exact domain is unknown.

reveal_personal_emails.description: Whether to include verified personal emails if a corporate work email is unavailable (default: false).

name: enrich_person
